reviewed_by: Codex review of durable provider reasoning effort across the goal lifecycle
reason: Provider reasoning effort was transient until a normal message completed, while Start, Resume, and automatic goal continuation built Core-side requests that omitted it. The selection verifies session metadata persistence, exact API serialization, UI prevention of Resume during the save, Core propagation through initial and continued goal turns, and the real production-bundle LAN workflow across desktop Chromium and emulated mobile Chromium/WebKit.
exclusions: Full backend and frontend suites, unrelated chat/provider/harness tests, native Rust tests, physical devices, and unrelated Playwright areas are excluded. The selected real-Core goal-lifecycle journey covers the affected UI, persistence, refresh, resume, and continuation boundaries; no origin-sensitive browser API changed.
